name: structural-file-graphing-reconciliation
body:
Source SPEC.md (the 0.17.0 brief, §1–§7) against the branch graph:
- MATCH (n:File) returns 125 File nodes.
- The repo-root File nodes are exactly AGENTS.md, README.md, and build.rs; Cargo.toml, install.sh, Formula/*.rb, .github/**, and LICENSE carry zero File node.
- The brief's targetless list is absent from the File-node set.
- The Markdown precedent holds: modules md.apg, md.opencode-suite/agents, md.plans exist and the md heading Structs are present, so the bundled scanner carries the Markdown stream. The repo-root module md.apg is the checkout-directory basename and moves to the repo-relative md. (see requirements.requirement.md-lang-id-preserved); the non-root dir modules and all heading Struct FQNs (md.AGENTS.md.*, md.README.md.*, md.opencode-suite/agents/*.md.*) stand.
- The shipped code-extension claim set is the union of the code frontends' extensions: the 13 originally listed plus .cxx .c++ .hpp .hh .hxx .tpp .ipp (C++) and .mts .cts .mjs .cjs (TS/JS) — 11 extensions — as stated in requirements.requirement.structural-format-claiming. .c falls to misc by design, because the C++ frontend excludes it.
- Ruby carries zero frontend, so Formula/*.rb falls to misc (apg-ruby is pending).
